sql: SELECT 'Movie' kind,COUNT(*) rows,COUNT(DISTINCT MID) distinct_id,SUM(MID!=TRIM(MID)) padded FROM Movie UNION ALL SELECT 'Person',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT PID),SUM(PID!=TRIM(PID)) FROM Person UNION ALL SELECT 'M_Cast',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT MID||'|'||PID),SUM(MID!=TRIM(MID) OR PID!=TRIM(PID)) FROM M_Cast
SELECT Gender,COUNT(*) n FROM Person GROUP BY Gender

SELECT 'cast' table_name,COUNT(*) rows,COUNT(DISTINCT MID||'|'||PID) pairs,COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(MID)||'|'||TRIM(PID)) normalized_pairs,SUM(MID!=TRIM(MID)) padded_mid,SUM(PID!=TRIM(PID)) padded_pid FROM M_Cast UNION ALL SELECT 'Person',COUNT(*),COUNT(DISTINCT PID),COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(PID)),SUM(PID!=TRIM(PID)),SUM(PID!=TRIM(PID)) FROM Person

WITH persons AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT PID,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Female' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) bad FROM Person GROUP BY PID), cast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(MID) mid,TRIM(PID) pid FROM M_Cast), cast_flags AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.mid,COUNT(*) actors,MAX(COALESCE(p.bad,1)) bad FROM cast_rows c LEFT JOIN persons p ON c.pid=p.PID GROUP BY c.mid), movie_flags AS (SELECT m.MID,m.title,CAST(substr(m.year,-4) AS INTEGER) year,COALESCE(c.actors,0) actors,COALESCE(c.bad,0) bad FROM Movie m LEFT JOIN cast_flags c ON m.MID=c.mid) SELECT COUNT(*) movies,SUM(actors=0) empty_cast,SUM(actors>0 AND bad=0) female_only,SUM(actors>0 AND bad>0) rejected FROM movie_flags

WITH persons AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT PID,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Female' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) bad FROM Person GROUP BY PID), cast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(MID) mid,TRIM(PID) pid FROM M_Cast), cast_flags AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.mid,COUNT(*) actors,MAX(COALESCE(p.bad,1)) bad FROM cast_rows c LEFT JOIN persons p ON c.pid=p.PID GROUP BY c.mid), movie_flags AS (SELECT m.MID,m.title,CAST(substr(m.year,-4) AS INTEGER) year,COALESCE(c.actors,0) actors,COALESCE(c.bad,0) bad FROM Movie m LEFT JOIN cast_flags c ON m.MID=c.mid) SELECT MID,title,year,actors FROM movie_flags WHERE actors>0 AND bad=0 ORDER BY year,MID

WITH persons AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT PID,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Female' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) bad FROM Person GROUP BY PID), cast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(MID) mid,TRIM(PID) pid FROM M_Cast), cast_flags AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.mid,COUNT(*) actors,MAX(COALESCE(p.bad,1)) bad FROM cast_rows c LEFT JOIN persons p ON c.pid=p.PID GROUP BY c.mid), movie_flags AS (SELECT m.MID,m.title,CAST(substr(m.year,-4) AS INTEGER) year,COALESCE(c.actors,0) actors,COALESCE(c.bad,0) bad FROM Movie m LEFT JOIN cast_flags c ON m.MID=c.mid) SELECT year,COUNT(*) total,SUM(actors=0) empty_cast,SUM(actors>0 AND bad=0) female_only FROM movie_flags GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
SELECT PID,COUNT(*) n,COUNT(DISTINCT Gender) genders,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Gender) values_seen FROM Person GROUP BY PID HAVING COUNT(*)>1 ORDER BY genders DESC,PID LIMIT 15

WITH persons AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT PID,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Female' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) bad FROM Person GROUP BY PID), cast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(MID) mid,TRIM(PID) pid FROM M_Cast), cast_flags AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT c.mid,COUNT(*) actors,MAX(COALESCE(p.bad,1)) bad FROM cast_rows c LEFT JOIN persons p ON c.pid=p.PID GROUP BY c.mid), movie_flags AS (SELECT m.MID,m.title,CAST(substr(m.year,-4) AS INTEGER) year,COALESCE(c.actors,0) actors,COALESCE(c.bad,0) bad FROM Movie m LEFT JOIN cast_flags c ON m.MID=c.mid) SELECT year,COUNT(*) total_movies,100.0*SUM(actors>0 AND bad=0)/COUNT(*) female_percentage FROM movie_flags GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

WITH persons AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT PID,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Male' OR Gender='None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) known_bad,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unknown,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) female FROM Person GROUP BY PID),c AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT DISTINCT MID,TRIM(PID) pid FROM M_Cast),flags AS (SELECT c.MID,COUNT(*) n,MAX(COALESCE(p.known_bad,0)) bad,MAX(CASE WHEN p.PID IS NULL OR p.unknown=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unknown,MAX(COALESCE(p.female,0)) female FROM c LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.PID=c.pid GROUP BY c.MID),mf AS(SELECT m.MID,m.title,CAST(substr(m.year,-4) AS INTEGER) year,f.* FROM Movie m JOIN flags f ON f.MID=m.MID) SELECT MID,title,year,n,bad,unknown,female FROM mf WHERE bad=0 ORDER BY year,MID

WITH persons AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT PID,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Male' OR Gender='None' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) known_bad,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unknown,MAX(CASE WHEN Gender='Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) female FROM Person GROUP BY PID),c AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT DISTINCT MID,TRIM(PID) pid FROM M_Cast),flags AS (SELECT c.MID,COUNT(*) n,MAX(COALESCE(p.known_bad,0)) bad,MAX(CASE WHEN p.PID IS NULL OR p.unknown=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) unknown,MAX(COALESCE(p.female,0)) female FROM c LEFT JOIN persons p ON p.PID=c.pid GROUP BY c.MID),mf AS(SELECT m.MID,m.title,CAST(substr(m.year,-4) AS INTEGER) year,f.* FROM Movie m JOIN flags f ON f.MID=m.MID) SELECT year,COUNT(*) total_movies,100.0*SUM(bad=0)/COUNT(*) ignored_null_percentage,100.0*SUM(bad=0 AND unknown=0)/COUNT(*) explicit_female_percentage FROM mf GROUP BY year ORDER BY year
